name: Rilavek
tagline: Rilavek is a managed file transfer bridge for solo developers and indie builders
description: Rilavek is a managed file transfer bridge for solo developers and indie builders. Accept files via HTTP/TUS (resumable browser & mobile uploads) or legacy protocols like FTP/FTPS/SFTP, and stream them directly into any S3-compatible storage (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, MinIO, etc.). Files never touch our servers (true zero-knowledge pass-through), no extra storage costs or privacy risks. Set up resumable uploads in minutes with no backend code, no presigned URLs, and no servers.
